type.description:
### ⚠️ Requires [Sync](https://modrinth.com/mod/sync) to be installed! ⚠️

## Entity Texture Overlay

---


[Power Types](https://0vergrown.github.io/Sync-Documentation-Website/?file=power_types/entity_texture_overlay)

Applies custom textures to entities, either as replacements or overlays. Supports both "wide" and "slim" player models with color tinting options.

Type ID: `sync:entity_texture_overlay`

---

### Examples

```json
{
    "type": "sync:entity_texture_overlay",
    "wide_texture_location": "mymod:textures/overlay/wide_glow.png",
    "slim_texture_location": "mymod:textures/overlay/slim_glow.png",
    "render_as_overlay": true,
    "show_first_person": true,
    "red": 0.0,
    "green": 1.0,
    "blue": 0.0,
    "alpha": 0.5,
    "condition": {
        "type": "apoli:sneaking"
    }
}
```
This example applies a semi-transparent green glow overlay when sneaking, visible in first person.
```json
{
    "type": "sync:entity_texture_overlay",
    "wide_texture_location": "mymod:textures/skins/hero_wide.png",
    "slim_texture_location": "mymod:textures/skins/hero_slim.png",
    "render_as_overlay": false,
    "hide_cape": true,
    "condition": {
        "type": "apoli:equipped_item",
        "equipment_slot": "mainhand",
        "item_condition": {
            "type": "apoli:ingredient",
            "ingredient": {
                "item": "minecraft:nether_star"
            }
        }
    }
}
```
This example replaces the player's skin texture when holding a nether star, hiding their cape.

title: Entity Texture Overlay (Power Type) date: 2024-01-07

Entity Texture Overlay

Power Types

Applies custom textures to entities, either as replacements or overlays. Supports both "wide" and "slim" player models with color tinting options.

Type ID: sync:entity_texture_overlay

Fields

Field Type Default Description
wide_texture_location Identifier Texture location for wide-armed models.
slim_texture_location Identifier Texture location for slim-armed models.
show_first_person Boolean false Whether to show the texture in first-person view.
render_as_overlay Boolean false If true, renders over existing texture; if false, replaces it.
red Float 1.0 Red color channel multiplier (0.0-1.0).
green Float 1.0 Green color channel multiplier (0.0-1.0).
blue Float 1.0 Blue color channel multiplier (0.0-1.0).
alpha Float 1.0 Alpha/transparency (0.0-1.0).
hide_cape Boolean false Whether to hide the player's cape.

Examples

{
    "type": "sync:entity_texture_overlay",
    "wide_texture_location": "mymod:textures/overlay/wide_glow.png",
    "slim_texture_location": "mymod:textures/overlay/slim_glow.png",
    "render_as_overlay": true,
    "show_first_person": true,
    "red": 0.0,
    "green": 1.0,
    "blue": 0.0,
    "alpha": 0.5,
    "condition": {
        "type": "apoli:sneaking"
    }
}

This example applies a semi-transparent green glow overlay when sneaking, visible in first person.
